entities.name: Draw River Forest Reserve
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The Draw River Forest Reserve is found in Ghana. It was established in 1937, and covers 235 km2 (91 sq mi). The Draw River flows through the eastern part of the reserve. It lies at an elevation of 75 m above sea level.
